issues: The dialogue excerpts are exact but incomplete quotations of the supplied verses; the scene otherwise avoids adding events from the omitted text.
The narration is an exact excerpt, but the dialogue includes only part of Nephi’s longer speech. The summary and facts correctly report its additional content.

The summary states that Laman and Lemuel are angry with the narrator, but 1 Nephi 3:28 says Laman was angry with the narrator and their father; Lemuel is described as angry because he hearkened to Laman, without explicitly specifying whom his anger was directed toward.
The verse identifies the addressees only as “us”; their identities are unspecified in this scene.
